components.css: .ds-contribution{font-family:var(--font-body,"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif);padding:54px;border-radius:var(--company-radius,20px);background:var(--ember-ground,#142e51);color:var(--ember-ink,#fafcff)}.ds-contribution h3{font-size:18px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 22px}.ds-contribution-title{font:400 clamp(32px,3.1vw,44px)/1.12 var(--font-display,"Instrument Serif",Georgia,serif);margin:0 0 18px}.ds-contribution-copy{font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;max-width:36ch;color:var(--ember-muted,#c1d0e1);margin:0 0 30px}.ds-contribution a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 22px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--ember-ink,#fafcff);color:var(--ember-ground,#142e51);font-size:13px;text-decoration:none}.ds-contribution a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ember-ink,#fafcff);outline-offset:4px}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-contribution a:hover{background:var(--ember-muted,#c1d0e1)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-contribution a{transition:transform 150ms ease-out,background-color 150ms ease-out}.ds-contribution a:active{transform:scale(.96)}}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-contribution{padding:30px 25px;border-radius:16px}}

narrative.overview:
The supplied navy infinity emblem anchors a quiet, spacious identity. Local serif display type gives the introduction its voice; practical sans type keeps reading, controls and evidence clear. Sarvam informs product display and card interaction; Gnani informs the company-to-contribution hierarchy. Their assets and source styles are not copied.

The company introduction gives Anantam room to speak before presenting its first contribution. Analytical surfaces retain the same identity with task-specific density, visible scope and progressive disclosure. The benchmark is evidence of the company's work, rather than the entirety of its identity.
keyCharacteristics: Local serif display and practical sans
Spacious company introduction and focused analytical workspaces
Native disclosures and visible evidence scope

rules.name: The Semantic Role Rule
rules.body: Use the shared semantic roles across themes; use the fixed contribution roles inside the navy company card.

rules.name: The Honest Loading Rule
rules.body: Show branded loading only while analytical data is pending; never hold content for a brand sequence.

dos: **Do** preserve the supplied navy infinity emblem and local type system.
**Do** use semantic color roles and keep scope and uncertainty visible.
**Do** preserve useful company content without JavaScript or benchmark data.
**Do** respect reduced motion with static artwork and immediate state changes.
**Do** retain benchmark model IDs, deep links and generated-data provenance.
donts: **Don't** invent metrics, customers, trust logos or future product launches.
**Don't** edit generated results or scoring definitions by hand.
**Don't** show a pending-data loader on the company homepage.
**Don't** turn the finite company introduction into continuous decorative motion.
**Don't** force analytical chart geometry into the company's three-section composition.
